journal_lines: §aGreen bloom on the rock face. §oSmells faintly sweet, almost mineral-sour.§o §lCopper§l behind it.
§aBlue-green streak in the wall. Followed it. Good vein.
§aCopper turns green down here. §oDon't know why. Interesting.§o Brought the green copper.
§aMalachite staining on the stone, then the ore behind. Took both.
§aThe pickaxe rang low when it hit. §lCopper§l gives a different note than stone.
§aChunky ore, blue-streaked and warm in the paw. Heavier than it looks.
§aBright patches where the oxidation hadn't reached yet. §oFresh copper, almost orange.§o Took the bright ones.
§aVerdigris on the ceiling first. Looked up, found the vein above me.
§aDust came off blue-green when I struck it. §lCopper§l seam, wide and well-embedded.
§aFour separate nodules in a cluster. §oLike eggs in a nest the stone had made.§o Took them carefully.
§aRan my paw along the wall and felt the texture change. Copper there, rough and soft at once.
§aSmall vein, but dense. §lCopper§l ore solid all the way through.
